component.name: Omarchy Notes (Rust)
component.summary: Local notes, Rust edition in early access

description.p: The separate Rust edition of Omarchy Notes keeps rich notes in a local SQLite library, without an account. This early-access candidate has not completed v1 release acceptance.

ul.li: Rich writing, headings, lists, checklists, basic tables, images and attached files
Nested folders, pinning, prefix search and recoverable deletion
Quick Note and durable command-line capture
Portable import/export and verified library backups

description.p: Rust uses its preview data directory and coexists with the Qt edition. Tags and Smart Folder interfaces are deferred; existing records remain preserved. Quotation libraries require Rust and returning to Qt uses a pre-upgrade backup.
Early-access Rust edition; stable release gates remain open.
